# LazyJobs

> Swipe. Match. Get Hired. A Tinder-style job matching app powered by AI.

LazyJobs matches job seekers with openings based on their CV. Upload your CV, swipe through ranked job matches, see your skill gaps and get AI-generated cover letters and application answers. Jobs are aggregated from sources such as Arbetsförmedlingen, EURES and Remotive.

Built for job seekers who want a faster, lower-effort way to find and apply for relevant jobs.

## Links

- [LazyJobs app](https://lazyjobs.app/): Sign up, upload your CV and start swiping.
